# QuizBuffet: Full Cert Reference

Last updated: 2026-09-06
Site: https://quizbuffet.com

QuizBuffet provides free practice tests for high-demand certifications across IT, cybersecurity, cloud, healthcare, trades, transportation, and finance. All content is browser-based: no signup, no tracking of personal data. Progress is stored in localStorage.

## CompTIA Cloud+ (CV0-004)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-cloud-plus/
Total questions: 1200

Cloud+ validates your ability to deploy, secure, and manage cloud environments across providers. It covers architecture decisions, automation with IaC, backup and recovery, identity management, DevOps pipelines, and troubleshooting real-world cloud issues. Built for professionals with 2-3 years of hands-on cloud or systems experience.

### Domains
- 1.0 Cloud Architecture (23% of exam): 384 questions
- 2.0 Deployment (19% of exam): 208 questions
- 3.0 Operations (17% of exam): 164 questions
- 4.0 Security (19% of exam): 232 questions
- 5.0 DevOps Fundamentals (10% of exam): 112 questions
- 6.0 Troubleshooting (12% of exam): 100 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the Cloud+ exam?**
A: Up to 90 questions, multiple-choice and performance-based, in 90 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for Cloud+?**
A: You need 750 out of 900.

**Q: How much does CompTIA Cloud+ cost?**
A: CompTIA's standard exam price is currently around $400 USD. Check CompTIA's official store for the current rate.

**Q: Is Cloud+ vendor-neutral?**
A: Yes. Unlike AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certifications, Cloud+ tests cloud concepts, security, and operations that apply across providers rather than one specific platform.

**Q: Cloud+ vs AWS Solutions Architect, which should I get first?**
A: Cloud+ is a good vendor-neutral foundation if you are not yet committed to one cloud platform or need to work across multiple. If your job or target role is specifically AWS, an AWS certification will carry more direct weight with hiring managers.

**Q: How long is Cloud+ certification valid?**
A: Cloud+ is valid for 3 years and renews through CompTIA's Continuing Education program.

## CompTIA ITF+ (FC0-U61)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-itf-plus/
Total questions: 1900

ITF+ (IT Fundamentals+) is a pre-professional certification covering core IT concepts for people exploring a career in technology. It covers computing basics, hardware, networking, operating systems, software, databases, and security fundamentals. No prior experience required: ideal for advanced end users and those considering CompTIA A+.

### Domains
- IT Concepts and Terminology (17% of exam): 256 questions
- Infrastructure (22% of exam): 464 questions
- Applications and Software (18% of exam): 408 questions
- Software Development (12% of exam): 144 questions
- Database Fundamentals (11% of exam): 184 questions
- Security (20% of exam): 444 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Is CompTIA ITF+ retired?**
A: Yes. The ITF+ exam (FC0-U61) retired on July 31, 2025 and was replaced by CompTIA Tech+ (FC0-U71), which launched in August 2024. An ITF+ certification you already hold stays valid for life. The fundamentals tested here (hardware, software, networking, security, databases, and basic development) carry over to Tech+, so these questions still work as a foundation for the newer exam.

**Q: Should I take Tech+ instead of ITF+?**
A: If you have not yet tested, Tech+ is the only option now. Use this practice test to build the same core IT vocabulary and concepts, then check the Tech+ objectives on CompTIA's site for the added coverage of AI, cloud, and modern devices before you sit the exam.

**Q: How many questions are on the ITF+ exam?**
A: A maximum of 75 multiple-choice questions in 60 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for ITF+?**
A: You need 650 out of 900.

**Q: How much does CompTIA ITF+ cost?**
A: CompTIA's standard exam price is currently around $130 to $150 USD, notably cheaper than CompTIA's professional-level certifications since ITF+ is a pre-professional exam. Check CompTIA's official store for the current rate.

**Q: Do I need ITF+ before A+?**
A: No, it is not a prerequisite for A+ or any other CompTIA certification. It exists as an optional on-ramp for complete beginners or students deciding whether IT is the right career path.

## CompTIA CySA+ (CS0-003)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-cysa-plus/
Total questions: 1600

CySA+ (Cybersecurity Analyst+) certifies analysts who detect and respond to threats, perform vulnerability management, and conduct incident response. It covers security operations, threat hunting, vulnerability scanning and prioritization, incident handling, and communicating findings to stakeholders. Aimed at professionals with 4 years of hands-on SOC or incident response experience.

### Domains
- Security Operations (33% of exam): 688 questions
- Vulnerability Management (30% of exam): 528 questions
- Incident Response Management (20% of exam): 172 questions
- Reporting and Communication (17% of exam): 212 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Is CompTIA CySA+ CS0-003 being retired?**
A: Yes. CompTIA launched CySA+ v4 (CS0-004) on June 23, 2026, and CS0-003 is scheduled to retire on December 22, 2026. If you have not scheduled your exam yet, check CompTIA's site for which version you'll actually sit, since this practice bank is built around CS0-003's objectives and CS0-004 adds updated cloud/hybrid and AI-related security content.

**Q: What is the passing score for CySA+?**
A: You need 750 out of 900.

**Q: How much does CompTIA CySA+ cost?**
A: CompTIA's standard exam price is currently around $400 USD. Check CompTIA's official store for the current rate.

**Q: Do you need Security+ before CySA+?**
A: Not required, but CompTIA recommends Network+ and Security+ or equivalent knowledge plus about 4 years of hands-on SOC or incident-response experience. Most candidates take Security+ first.

**Q: Is CySA+ harder than Security+?**
A: Yes. Security+ is foundational; CySA+ assumes that foundation and tests hands-on threat detection, analysis, and incident response with performance-based simulations, not just definitions.

**Q: CySA+ vs PenTest+, what is the difference?**
A: CySA+ focuses on the defensive side, monitoring, detecting, and responding to threats. PenTest+ focuses on the offensive side, planning and executing authorized penetration tests. Some security analysts pursue both.

## CompTIA PenTest+ (PT0-003)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-pentest-plus/
Total questions: 2160

PenTest+ certifies professionals who can plan, scope, and execute penetration tests across networks, applications, and cloud environments, and communicate findings to stakeholders.

### Domains
- Engagement Management (13% of exam): 416 questions
- Reconnaissance and Enumeration (21% of exam): 324 questions
- Vulnerability Discovery and Analysis (17% of exam): 196 questions
- Attacks and Exploits (35% of exam): 884 questions
- Post-exploitation and Lateral Movement (14% of exam): 340 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How much is the PT0-003 exam voucher?**
A: CompTIA’s standard exam price is currently around $400 USD. Check CompTIA’s official store for the current rate, since it can change and authorized training partners sometimes bundle it differently.

**Q: Is PenTest+ harder than Security+?**
A: Yes. Security+ is a foundational exam; PenTest+ assumes that foundation plus Network+-level knowledge and tests hands-on penetration testing skills with performance-based simulations, not just multiple-choice recall. Most people take Security+ (and often Network+) before PenTest+.

**Q: Is there free PenTest+ training?**
A: CompTIA publishes free PT0-003 exam objectives you can study from directly, and QuizBuffet’s practice questions here are free with no signup. Paid options like CertMaster Learn add structured lessons and labs on top of that.

**Q: How many questions and how long is the PenTest+ exam?**
A: Up to 90 questions, multiple-choice and performance-based, in 165 minutes.

**Q: What is the PenTest+ passing score?**
A: You need 750 out of 900 on CompTIA’s scaled score.

**Q: Does PenTest+ expire?**
A: Yes, PenTest+ certification is valid for 3 years and renews through CompTIA’s Continuing Education program or by earning a qualifying higher-level certification.

## CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-a-plus-core-1/
Total questions: 2100

A+ Core 1 (220-1201) is the first of two exams required for the CompTIA A+ certification. It covers mobile devices, networking, hardware, virtualization, cloud computing, and hardware troubleshooting.

### Domains
- Mobile Devices (15% of exam): 264 questions
- Networking (20% of exam): 500 questions
- Hardware (25% of exam): 856 questions
- Virtualization and Cloud Computing (11% of exam): 100 questions
- Hardware and Network Troubleshooting (29% of exam): 380 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the A+ Core 1 exam?**
A: Up to 90 questions, multiple-choice and performance-based, in 90 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for A+ Core 1?**
A: You need 675 out of 900.

**Q: How much does CompTIA A+ cost?**
A: Each exam (Core 1 and Core 2) costs $274 as of 2026, so budget around $548 total since you need to pass both to earn the certification.

**Q: Do I need both Core 1 and Core 2 to get A+?**
A: Yes. Passing only one exam does not earn any certification on its own; you need to pass both 220-1201 (Core 1) and 220-1202 (Core 2) within CompTIA's eligibility window.

**Q: Is A+ Core 1 or Core 2 harder?**
A: Most candidates find Core 1 more hands-on and hardware-heavy (mobile devices, networking, hardware, virtualization and cloud, troubleshooting), while Core 2 leans more into operating systems, security, and procedures. Neither is universally harder; it depends on your background.

**Q: Is CompTIA A+ worth it for beginners?**
A: Yes, it is the standard entry credential for help desk and desktop support roles and does not require any prior certification or work experience, just the recommended 12 months of hands-on exposure.

## CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-a-plus-core-2/
Total questions: 3200

A+ Core 2 (220-1202) is the second of two exams required for the CompTIA A+ certification. It covers operating systems, security, software troubleshooting, and operational procedures for IT support specialists.

### Domains
- Operating Systems (28% of exam): 1200 questions
- Security (28% of exam): 1040 questions
- Software Troubleshooting (23% of exam): 220 questions
- Operational Procedures (21% of exam): 740 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the A+ Core 2 exam?**
A: Up to 90 questions, multiple-choice and performance-based, in 90 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for A+ Core 2?**
A: You need 700 out of 900.

**Q: How much does A+ Core 2 cost?**
A: The exam costs $274 as of 2026. You also need to pass Core 1 (220-1201), also $274, so the full A+ certification runs about $548 total.

**Q: What is on the A+ Core 2 exam?**
A: Operating systems (installing, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile OSes), security (physical security, malware, social engineering, wireless security), software troubleshooting, and operational procedures (documentation, change management, safety, professionalism).

**Q: Should I take Core 1 or Core 2 first?**
A: CompTIA does not require a specific order, but most study plans go Core 1 (hardware and networking) first since Core 2 builds on some of that foundation, especially in troubleshooting.

**Q: How long is A+ certification valid?**
A: CompTIA A+ is valid for 3 years and renews through CompTIA's Continuing Education program or by earning a qualifying higher-level certification.

## CompTIA Network+ (N10-009)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-network-plus/
Total questions: 1119

Network+ certifies professionals who can deploy wired and wireless networks, configure network services, implement security hardening, and troubleshoot performance and availability issues. It covers networking concepts, IP addressing, routing, switching, wireless, cloud connectivity, and network troubleshooting. Recommended for professionals with 9-12 months of networking experience.

### Domains
- 1.0 Networking Concepts (23% of exam): 318 questions
- 2.0 Network Implementation (20% of exam): 112 questions
- 3.0 Network Operations (19% of exam): 201 questions
- 4.0 Network Security (14% of exam): 100 questions
- 5.0 Network Troubleshooting (24% of exam): 388 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the Network+ exam?**
A: Up to 90 questions, multiple-choice and performance-based, in 90 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for Network+?**
A: You need 720 out of 900 on CompTIA's scaled score.

**Q: How much does CompTIA Network+ cost?**
A: CompTIA's standard exam price is currently around $400 USD. Check CompTIA's official store for the current rate.

**Q: Is Network+ harder than A+?**
A: Yes, it goes deeper into networking concepts, protocols, and troubleshooting than A+'s broader IT support coverage, but it does not require A+ first. Many candidates take A+ then Network+ then Security+ in that order.

**Q: How long is Network+ certification valid?**
A: Network+ is valid for 3 years and renews through CompTIA's Continuing Education program or by earning a qualifying higher-level certification.

**Q: Is this Network+ practice test free?**
A: Yes. Every Network+ practice question on QuizBuffet is free, with instant feedback and an explanation for each answer, no signup required.

## CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-security-plus/
Total questions: 1900

Security+ certifies professionals who can assess enterprise security posture, monitor hybrid environments, operate within governance and compliance frameworks, and identify and respond to security incidents.

### Domains
- 1.0 General Security Concepts (12% of exam): 164 questions
- 2.0 Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations (22% of exam): 446 questions
- 3.0 Security Architecture (18% of exam): 199 questions
- 4.0 Security Operations (28% of exam): 644 questions
- 5.0 Security Program Management and Oversight (20% of exam): 447 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How hard is the Security+ SY0-701 exam?**
A: It is a fair entry-level security exam, but it is broad. You face up to 90 multiple-choice and performance-based questions covering threats, cryptography, identity, and incident response. The performance-based questions trip people up most, so practice applying concepts, not just memorizing terms.

**Q: How many questions are on the Security+ exam?**
A: You get a maximum of 90 questions in 90 minutes, mixing multiple-choice with hands-on performance-based items. QuizBuffet drills each exam domain so the format feels familiar before test day.

**Q: What score do you need to pass Security+?**
A: You need 750 on a scale of 100 to 900. It is pass or fail, and there is no penalty for guessing, so answer every question.

**Q: Do you need experience before taking Security+?**
A: It is not required, but CompTIA recommends Network+ and about two years of IT administration with a security focus. Plenty of people pass with less by leaning on structured study and practice questions.

**Q: Is Security+ worth it?**
A: Yes, especially early in a security career. It meets the US DoD 8140 baseline for many roles and is one of the most requested certifications on entry-level security job postings.

**Q: How long is Security+ certification valid?**
A: Security+ is valid for three years. You renew it by earning continuing education units or by passing a higher-level CompTIA exam.

## CompTIA Data+ (DA0-002)
Vendor: CompTIA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/comptia-data-plus/
Total questions: 1000

Data+ certifies professionals who can translate business requirements into data-driven decisions by acquiring, preparing, and transforming data, applying statistical methods, creating visualizations, and adhering to governance and quality standards throughout the data life cycle.

### Domains
- Data Concepts and Environments (20% of exam): 392 questions
- Data Acquisition and Preparation (22% of exam): 160 questions
- Data Analysis (24% of exam): 120 questions
- Visualization and Reporting (20% of exam): 144 questions
- Data Governance (14% of exam): 184 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the Data+ exam?**
A: Up to 90 questions, multiple-choice and performance-based, in 90 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for Data+?**
A: You need 720 out of 900.

**Q: How much does CompTIA Data+ cost?**
A: CompTIA's standard exam price is currently around $400 USD. Check CompTIA's official store for the current rate.

**Q: Is Data+ a good certification for beginners?**
A: It works well for people with some hands-on exposure to spreadsheets, basic SQL, or BI tools who want a vendor-neutral credential proving data literacy, but CompTIA recommends 1.5 to 2 years of relevant experience rather than treating it as a complete beginner exam.

**Q: Data+ vs a data analytics bootcamp certificate, which is better?**
A: Data+ is a proctored, third-party-validated exam that carries more weight as a resume credential; a bootcamp certificate usually goes deeper into a specific tool stack (like Python or Tableau) but is self-graded and vendor-specific to that program.

**Q: How long is Data+ certification valid?**
A: Data+ is valid for 3 years and renews through CompTIA's Continuing Education program.

## Cisco CCNA (200-301)
Vendor: Cisco
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/cisco-ccna/
Total questions: 800

CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate, exam 200-301 v1.1) certifies professionals who can install, configure, operate, and troubleshoot small- to medium-sized networks. It covers network fundamentals, network access, IP connectivity (routing, OSPF), IP services (NAT, NTP, DHCP, QoS), security fundamentals, and automation and programmability, including AI/ML in network operations and REST APIs.

### Domains
- 1.0 Network Fundamentals (20% of exam): 160 questions
- 2.0 Network Access (20% of exam): 160 questions
- 3.0 IP Connectivity (25% of exam): 200 questions
- 4.0 IP Services (10% of exam): 80 questions
- 5.0 Security Fundamentals (15% of exam): 120 questions
- 6.0 Automation and Programmability (10% of exam): 80 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the CCNA exam?**
A: Cisco does not publish a fixed count since question types and length vary by exam form, but most candidates report roughly 100 to 120 items (multiple-choice, drag-and-drop, and simulation) in the 120-minute window.

**Q: What is the passing score for CCNA?**
A: Cisco does not publish one fixed passing score; it is set per exam form using a scaled scoring model, commonly discussed as being in the 800 to 850 range out of 1000. Your score report shows pass or fail plus a section-by-section breakdown.

**Q: How much does the CCNA exam cost?**
A: The CCNA 200-301 exam costs $300 USD, though pricing can vary by country.

**Q: How hard is the CCNA exam?**
A: It has a reputation as a tough associate-level exam because it packs networking fundamentals, IP connectivity, security, automation, and hands-on simulations into one 120-minute test. Most candidates study for two to four months, longer without prior networking experience.

**Q: How long is CCNA certification valid?**
A: CCNA certification is valid for 3 years, renewed through Cisco Continuing Education credits or by passing a qualifying exam.

**Q: Is this CCNA practice test free?**
A: Yes. Every CCNA practice question on QuizBuffet is free, with instant feedback and an explanation for each answer, no signup required.

## AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)
Vendor: AWS
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/aws-cloud-practitioner/
Total questions: 400

AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) validates foundational understanding of the AWS Cloud, value proposition and design principles, the shared responsibility model, security and compliance, core services across compute, storage, database, networking, AI/ML and analytics, plus pricing, billing, and support. Designed for individuals with up to 6 months of AWS exposure, it does not expect coding, architecture design, or troubleshooting skills.

### Domains
- 1.0 Cloud Concepts (24% of exam): 96 questions
- 2.0 Security and Compliance (30% of exam): 120 questions
- 3.0 Cloud Technology and Services (34% of exam): 136 questions
- 4.0 Billing, Pricing, and Support (12% of exam): 48 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the Cloud Practitioner exam?**
A: 65 questions total (50 scored, 15 unscored), multiple-choice and multiple-response, in 90 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for AWS Cloud Practitioner?**
A: You need 700 out of 1000 on AWS's scaled score.

**Q: How much does AWS Cloud Practitioner cost?**
A: It's AWS's foundational-tier exam, $100 USD. After you pass, AWS gives you a 50% discount voucher good on any other AWS exam for one year.

**Q: Do I need coding experience for Cloud Practitioner?**
A: No. It is designed for both technical and non-technical roles (sales, project management, finance) and tests conceptual understanding of the AWS Cloud, not hands-on building or coding.

**Q: Is Cloud Practitioner a good first AWS certification?**
A: Yes, it's AWS's recommended starting point if you have limited AWS exposure. Many candidates skip it and go straight to Solutions Architect Associate if they already have hands-on cloud experience.

**Q: How long is Cloud Practitioner certification valid?**
A: 3 years, renewed by retaking the exam, passing a higher-level AWS exam, or completing AWS's official recertification path.

## AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03)
Vendor: AWS
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/aws-solutions-architect-associate/
Total questions: 600

AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03) validates the ability to design solutions on AWS that are secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized, based on the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Aimed at candidates with at least 1 year of hands-on experience designing cloud solutions on AWS.

### Domains
- 1.0 Design Secure Architectures (30% of exam): 180 questions
- 2.0 Design Resilient Architectures (26% of exam): 156 questions
- 3.0 Design High-Performing Architectures (24% of exam): 144 questions
- 4.0 Design Cost-Optimized Architectures (20% of exam): 120 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the SAA-C03 exam?**
A: 65 questions total (50 scored, 15 unscored), multiple-choice and multiple-response, in 130 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for Solutions Architect Associate?**
A: You need 720 out of 1000.

**Q: How much does AWS Solutions Architect Associate cost?**
A: It's AWS's associate-tier exam, $150 USD.

**Q: Is Solutions Architect Associate hard?**
A: It has a reputation as one of the tougher associate exams because the scenario questions often have 2 or 3 technically-valid answers and you have to pick the one that best fits AWS's Well-Architected priorities (cost, security, performance, resilience). Most candidates study for 6 to 10 weeks with some hands-on AWS time.

**Q: Solutions Architect vs Developer Associate, which should I get first?**
A: Solutions Architect Associate is the most commonly recommended first associate cert since it covers the widest range of core AWS services at a design level. Developer Associate goes deeper into building and deploying application code, useful if your role is hands-on development rather than architecture.

**Q: How long is Solutions Architect Associate valid?**
A: 3 years, renewed by retaking the exam or passing a higher-level AWS exam.

## AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
Vendor: AWS
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/aws-ai-practitioner/
Total questions: 500

AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) validates foundational understanding of AI, machine learning, and generative AI on AWS, including foundation models, prompt engineering, responsible AI, and security for AI workloads. It is designed for professionals who use, evaluate, or work alongside AI/ML systems but are not necessarily building them.

### Domains
- 1.0 Fundamentals of AI and ML (20% of exam): 100 questions
- 2.0 Fundamentals of Generative AI (24% of exam): 120 questions
- 3.0 Applications of Foundation Models (28% of exam): 140 questions
- 4.0 Guidelines for Responsible AI (14% of exam): 70 questions
- 5.0 Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions (14% of exam): 70 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the AI Practitioner exam?**
A: 65 questions, multiple-choice and multiple-response, in 90 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for AWS AI Practitioner?**
A: You need 700 out of 1000.

**Q: How much does AWS AI Practitioner cost?**
A: It's AWS's foundational-tier exam, $100 USD. After you pass, AWS gives you a 50% discount voucher good on any other AWS exam for one year.

**Q: Do you need to know how to code for AI Practitioner?**
A: No. It is a foundational exam aimed at people who use or work alongside AI/ML systems (product managers, analysts, sales engineers), not the ML Engineer Associate exam's hands-on model-building content.

**Q: AI Practitioner vs ML Engineer Associate, what is the difference?**
A: AI Practitioner is foundational and conceptual: understanding AI/ML terms, use cases, and responsible AI. ML Engineer Associate is hands-on: building, training, tuning, and deploying ML models and pipelines on AWS. Most people without an ML engineering background start with AI Practitioner.

**Q: How long is AI Practitioner certification valid?**
A: 3 years, renewed by retaking the exam or passing a higher-level AWS exam.

## AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer Associate (MLA-C01)
Vendor: AWS
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/aws-ml-engineer-associate/
Total questions: 500

AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer Associate (MLA-C01) validates the ability to build, deploy, and operationalize ML solutions on AWS. It covers data preparation, model development, deployment and orchestration of ML workflows, and ongoing monitoring, maintenance, and security of ML solutions in production.

### Domains
- 1.0 Data Preparation for Machine Learning (28% of exam): 140 questions
- 2.0 ML Model Development (26% of exam): 130 questions
- 3.0 Deployment and Orchestration of ML Workflows (22% of exam): 110 questions
- 4.0 ML Solution Monitoring, Maintenance, and Security (24% of exam): 120 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the MLA-C01 exam?**
A: 65 questions, multiple-choice and multiple-response, in 130 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for ML Engineer Associate?**
A: You need 720 out of 1000.

**Q: How much does AWS ML Engineer Associate cost?**
A: It's AWS's associate-tier exam, $150 USD.

**Q: Do you need a data science background for ML Engineer Associate?**
A: It helps but is not strictly required. The exam focuses on the engineering side, data preparation, deploying models with SageMaker, orchestrating ML pipelines, and monitoring models in production, more than the mathematical theory behind the algorithms.

**Q: ML Engineer Associate vs AI Practitioner, which should I take?**
A: AI Practitioner is foundational and conceptual, aimed at anyone working alongside AI/ML. ML Engineer Associate is hands-on and technical, aimed at people who actually build, train, and deploy models. Most non-technical candidates start with AI Practitioner.

**Q: How long is ML Engineer Associate valid?**
A: 3 years, renewed by retaking the exam or passing a higher-level AWS exam.

## AWS Certified Generative AI Developer Professional (AIP-C01)
Vendor: AWS
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/aws-genai-developer-professional/
Total questions: 688

AWS Certified Generative AI Developer Professional (AIP-C01) validates the ability to integrate foundation models into applications and business workflows, including RAG and vector store design, agentic AI, prompt engineering and management, FM API integration, model deployment strategies, AI safety and governance, performance and cost optimization, and evaluation, monitoring, and troubleshooting of GenAI applications.

### Domains
- 1.0 Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance (31% of exam): 210 questions
- 2.0 Implementation and Integration (26% of exam): 188 questions
- 3.0 AI Safety, Security, and Governance (20% of exam): 136 questions
- 4.0 Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications (12% of exam): 80 questions
- 5.0 Testing, Validation, and Troubleshooting (11% of exam): 74 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the AIP-C01 exam?**
A: 75 questions total (65 scored, 10 unscored), multiple-choice and multiple-response, in 180 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for GenAI Developer Professional?**
A: You need 750 out of 1000.

**Q: How much does AWS GenAI Developer Professional cost?**
A: It's AWS's professional-tier exam, $300 USD.

**Q: Do you need AI Practitioner before GenAI Developer Professional?**
A: Not required by AWS, but it's a natural first step if you're newer to AI/ML on AWS. This exam assumes hands-on developer experience integrating foundation models, RAG, and agentic AI into real applications, not just conceptual AI knowledge.

**Q: How is this different from ML Engineer Associate?**
A: ML Engineer Associate covers building and deploying traditional ML models and pipelines. GenAI Developer Professional focuses specifically on generative AI: integrating foundation models, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows into production applications.

**Q: How long is GenAI Developer Professional valid?**
A: 3 years, renewed by retaking the exam or passing a higher-level AWS exam.

URL: https://quizbuffet.com/aws-cloudops-engineer-associate/

AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer Associate (SOA-C03) validates the ability to deploy, manage, and operate workloads on AWS. It covers monitoring and logging, performance optimization, reliability and business continuity, deployment and automation, security and compliance, and networking and content delivery, including hands-on use of CloudWatch, CloudFormation, Systems Manager, IAM, VPC, and the AWS CLI.

### Domains
- 1.0 Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization (22% of exam): 110 questions
- 2.0 Reliability and Business Continuity (22% of exam): 110 questions
- 3.0 Deployment, Provisioning, and Automation (22% of exam): 110 questions
- 4.0 Security and Compliance (16% of exam): 80 questions
- 5.0 Networking and Content Delivery (18% of exam): 90 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the SOA-C03 exam?**
A: 65 questions total (50 scored, 15 unscored), multiple-choice and multiple-response, in 130 minutes.

**Q: What is the passing score for CloudOps Engineer Associate?**
A: You need 720 out of 1000.

**Q: How much does AWS CloudOps Engineer Associate cost?**
A: It's AWS's associate-tier exam, $150 USD.

**Q: What was this exam called before?**
A: SOA-C03 replaced the retired SysOps Administrator Associate (SOA-C02) exam, with expanded coverage of automation, observability, and modern operational tooling.

**Q: CloudOps Engineer vs Solutions Architect Associate, what is the difference?**
A: Solutions Architect Associate focuses on designing systems; CloudOps Engineer Associate focuses on running and operating them day to day, monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment automation, and incident response. Pick the one that matches whether you design or operate infrastructure in your role.

**Q: How long is CloudOps Engineer Associate valid?**
A: 3 years, renewed by retaking the exam or passing a higher-level AWS exam.

## AWS Certified Developer Associate (DVA-C02)
Vendor: AWS
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/aws-developer-associate/
Total questions: 500

AWS Certified Developer Associate (DVA-C02) validates the ability to develop, test, deploy, and debug AWS cloud-based applications. It covers application development with Lambda, API Gateway, SDKs, DynamoDB and other data stores, security (IAM, KMS, Cognito, secrets), CI/CD with CodeBuild/CodePipeline/CodeDeploy and SAM/CloudFormation, plus troubleshooting and optimization with CloudWatch and X-Ray.

### Domains
- 1.0 Development with AWS Services (32% of exam): 160 questions
- 2.0 Security (26% of exam): 130 questions
- 3.0 Deployment (24% of exam): 120 questions
- 4.0 Troubleshooting and Optimization (18% of exam): 90 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How hard is the AWS Certified Developer Associate exam?**
A: It is a moderate associate-level exam. The questions are scenario-based and expect you to know how core services like Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, and the CI/CD tools behave in practice, not just their definitions. With steady study and plenty of practice questions, most developers pass on the first try.

**Q: How many questions are on the DVA-C02 exam?**
A: The exam has 65 questions (50 scored and 15 unscored) in multiple-choice and multiple-response formats, and you get 130 minutes. QuizBuffet gives you a large bank of practice questions organized by the same exam domains.

**Q: What score do you need to pass the AWS Developer Associate?**
A: You need 720 on a scaled score of 100 to 1000. The exam is pass or fail, so you do not need a perfect score, just a solid grasp across every domain.

**Q: Do you need coding experience for the AWS Developer Associate?**
A: Yes, you should be comfortable with at least one high-level language and have hands-on time building and deploying applications on AWS. AWS recommends roughly one year of experience using its services before you sit the exam.

**Q: Is the AWS Certified Developer Associate worth it?**
A: For developers working with AWS, yes. It is one of the most requested cloud credentials on job postings and signals to hiring managers that you can build, deploy, and debug real applications on AWS rather than just talk about them.

**Q: How long is the AWS Developer Associate certification valid?**
A: AWS associate certifications are valid for three years. You renew by recertifying before it expires, which also keeps your knowledge current with service changes.

## Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
Vendor: Microsoft
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/microsoft-az-900/

Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) is the entry-level Azure certification. It covers cloud concepts (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, public/private/hybrid, shared responsibility, consumption-based pricing), core Azure architecture and services (regions, availability zones, compute, networking, storage, databases, identity), and Azure management and governance (cost management, Microsoft Entra, role-based access control, Azure Policy, monitoring, support).

**Q: What is the passing score for AZ-900?**
A: You need 700 out of 1000.

**Q: How much does AZ-900 cost?**
A: The exam costs $99 USD, Microsoft's standard fundamentals-tier price.

**Q: Do I need AZ-900 before AZ-104?**
A: No, it is not a prerequisite for AZ-104 or any other Azure role-based certification. It is an optional foundational exam useful if you are new to cloud concepts.

**Q: Is AZ-900 hard?**

**Q: How long is AZ-900 certification valid?**

## Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
Vendor: Microsoft
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/microsoft-az-104/
Total questions: 500

Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) validates skills for managing Azure subscriptions, identities and governance (Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Azure Policy, management groups), storage (storage accounts, Azure Files, Blob Storage, redundancy, lifecycle), compute (virtual machines, Container Instances, Container Apps, App Service, scale sets, ARM/Bicep), virtual networking (VNets, NSGs, Bastion, peering, private endpoints, load balancing, DNS), and monitoring with Azure Monitor and backup with Recovery Services and Site Recovery.

### Domains
- 1.0 Manage Azure identities and governance (23% of exam): 110 questions
- 2.0 Implement and manage storage (18% of exam): 85 questions
- 3.0 Deploy and manage Azure compute resources (22% of exam): 110 questions
- 4.0 Implement and manage virtual networking (18% of exam): 85 questions
- 5.0 Monitor and maintain Azure resources (19% of exam): 110 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How much does the AZ-104 exam cost?**
A: The AZ-104 exam costs $165 USD, though Microsoft sometimes offers discount vouchers through partner programs and events.

**Q: What is the passing score for AZ-104?**
A: You need 700 out of 1000 on Microsoft’s scaled score.

**Q: Is there a free way to renew the Azure Administrator cert?**
A: Yes. AZ-104 certification is valid for one year, and Microsoft lets you renew it for free with a short online assessment through Microsoft Learn before it expires, no proctored retake needed.

**Q: Is the AZ-104 exam online?**
A: You can take it online with a remote proctor from home or at a Pearson VUE testing center. Either way it is the same 40-60 question exam with a 120-minute time limit.

**Q: How hard is the AZ-104 exam?**
A: It is a solid step up from AZ-900: expect hands-on, scenario-based questions about identities, storage, compute, networking, and monitoring rather than definitions. Prior hands-on Azure experience makes a real difference.

**Q: Is AZ-900 required before AZ-104?**
A: No. AZ-104 has no prerequisite exam. Microsoft recommends about six months of hands-on Azure administration, and AZ-900 is a useful but optional warm-up if you are new to cloud concepts.

## Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Vendor: ISC2
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/isc2-cissp/
Total questions: 800

CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) validates deep technical and managerial knowledge across eight domains: security and risk management (governance, risk, BCP, ethics), asset security (classification, handling, data lifecycle), security architecture and engineering (security models, cryptography, site/facility design), communication and network security (OSI, secure protocols, segmentation), identity and access management (AAA, federation, RBAC/ABAC), security assessment and testing (vulnerability, pen testing, audits), security operations (logging, incident management, DR/BC), and software development security (SDLC, SAST/DAST, secure coding).

### Domains
- 1.0 Security and Risk Management (16% of exam): 128 questions
- 2.0 Asset Security (10% of exam): 80 questions
- 3.0 Security Architecture and Engineering (13% of exam): 104 questions
- 4.0 Communication and Network Security (13% of exam): 104 questions
- 5.0 Identity and Access Management (IAM) (13% of exam): 104 questions
- 6.0 Security Assessment and Testing (12% of exam): 96 questions
- 7.0 Security Operations (13% of exam): 104 questions
- 8.0 Software Development Security (10% of exam): 80 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How hard is the CISSP?**
A: It has a reputation as one of the toughest cybersecurity exams, less because any single question is obscure and more because it demands broad, managerial-level fluency across all eight domains at once, from risk governance to cryptography to secure software development. Most candidates study for two to four months.

**Q: How many questions are on the CISSP exam?**
A: The English CAT (computerized adaptive testing) exam runs 100 to 150 questions in up to 3 hours; the exact count depends on how the adaptive algorithm scores your answers as you go.

**Q: What is the CISSP passing score?**
A: You need 700 out of 1000 on the scaled score. CAT scoring means the exam can end as soon as it is statistically confident you are above or below that line.

**Q: How much does the CISSP cost?**
A: The exam fee is $749 USD through Pearson VUE, plus the ISC2 annual maintenance fee once you are certified.

**Q: Do you need 5 years of experience for CISSP?**
A: Yes, ISC2 requires 5 years of cumulative, paid work experience in 2 or more of the 8 CISSP domains (4 years if you hold a qualifying 4-year degree or an approved credential). Without enough experience yet, you can still pass the exam and hold the Associate of ISC2 designation until you qualify.

**Q: CISSP vs Security+, what is the difference?**
A: Security+ is an entry-level exam covering foundational security concepts. CISSP is a senior-level credential covering the same ground in far more depth plus governance, risk management, and secure architecture, and it requires years of real experience to fully certify. Most people take Security+ years before attempting CISSP.

## ITIL 4 Foundation (ITIL 4)
Vendor: PeopleCert
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/itil-foundation/
Total questions: 400

ITIL 4 Foundation introduces the ITIL service value system (SVS), the four dimensions of service management (organizations and people, information and technology, partners and suppliers, value streams and processes), the seven ITIL guiding principles, the six service value chain activities, and the purpose and key terms of 15 ITIL management practices, with seven of those practices covered in depth (continual improvement, change enablement, incident management, problem management, service request management, service desk, and service level management). It is the most commonly listed ITSM credential on enterprise IT job postings and a prerequisite for higher-level ITIL 4 qualifications.

### Domains
- 1.0 Key Concepts of Service Management (13% of exam): 50 questions
- 2.0 ITIL Guiding Principles (15% of exam): 60 questions
- 3.0 Four Dimensions of Service Management (5% of exam): 20 questions
- 4.0 ITIL Service Value System (2% of exam): 10 questions
- 5.0 Service Value Chain Activities (5% of exam): 20 questions
- 6.0 Purpose and Key Terms of 15 ITIL Practices (18% of exam): 70 questions
- 7.0 Seven ITIL Practices in Detail (42% of exam): 170 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the ITIL 4 Foundation exam?**
A: 40 multiple-choice questions in 60 minutes.

**Q: What is the ITIL 4 Foundation passing score?**
A: You need 26 out of 40, or 65%.

**Q: How much does ITIL 4 Foundation cost?**
A: PeopleCert’s exam fee is typically in the $300 to $450 range depending on region and whether you buy it standalone or bundled with training, and pricing is set by PeopleCert and its accredited training organizations rather than one fixed global price.

**Q: ITIL 4 vs ITIL v3, what changed?**
A: ITIL 4 replaced the old process-based lifecycle with the Service Value System and 34 management practices, added the 7 guiding principles, and put more emphasis on agile, DevOps, and Lean ways of working. If you hold ITIL v3 Foundation, PeopleCert offers a bridge module instead of retaking the full exam.

**Q: Is there a free ITIL mock exam?**
A: Yes, QuizBuffet’s ITIL 4 Foundation practice test is 400+ free mock exam questions across all seven exam areas, with instant feedback, no signup.

**Q: How long is ITIL 4 Foundation valid?**
A: Since the 2023 ITIL 4 scheme update, Foundation certification is valid for 3 years; before that update it did not expire. Check your certificate date against PeopleCert’s current policy.

## OSHA 10-Hour Construction (OSHA 10)
Vendor: OSHA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/osha-10-construction/
Total questions: 400

OSHA 10-Hour Construction is a voluntary outreach training program covering worker rights and employer responsibilities, the OSHA Focus Four hazards (falls, electrocution, struck-by, caught-in or between), personal protective equipment, and health hazards in construction. Many states and contractors require it before allowing workers on a construction site, and it is the most common entry credential in the U.S. construction industry.

### Domains
- 1.0 Introduction to OSHA (10% of exam): 40 questions
- 2.0 Falls (Focus Four) (18% of exam): 70 questions
- 3.0 Electrocution (Focus Four) (11% of exam): 45 questions
- 4.0 Struck-By Hazards (Focus Four) (11% of exam): 45 questions
- 5.0 Caught-In or Between (Focus Four) (11% of exam): 45 questions
- 6.0 Personal Protective Equipment (9% of exam): 35 questions
- 7.0 Health Hazards in Construction (9% of exam): 35 questions
- 8.0 Site Safety and Elective Topics (21% of exam): 85 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Is there a final exam for OSHA 10?**
A: OSHA itself does not mandate a single proctored exam, since the requirement is completing 10 hours of authorized outreach training, not passing a specific test. Most authorized online providers include periodic knowledge checks and a final quiz, commonly 20-25 questions with a 70% passing score and a few retry attempts, to confirm you absorbed the material before issuing your DOL card.

**Q: Can you fail OSHA 10?**
A: You can fail an individual quiz question or module check with some providers, but you are typically allowed to retake it until you pass, since the goal is completing all 10 hours of content, not filtering people out.

**Q: Is OSHA 10 online?**
A: Yes. OSHA-authorized outreach trainers offer OSHA 10 fully online as well as in person; either way you need the full 10 hours of authorized content to receive your DOL card.

**Q: How long does the OSHA 10 card last?**
A: The OSHA 10 card does not expire under federal rules, but some states, contractors, and project owners require refresher training every few years, so check your local and employer requirements.

**Q: How much does OSHA 10 cost?**
A: OSHA does not set a fixed price since training is delivered by independent authorized providers; expect to pay roughly $25 to $90 depending on the provider and format.

**Q: Is OSHA 10 required for construction workers?**
A: Federal OSHA does not require the 10-hour card, but several states (including New York, Nevada, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Missouri, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island) require it for many construction jobs, and many general contractors and project owners require it as a condition of site access.

## OSHA 30-Hour Construction (OSHA 30)
Vendor: OSHA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/osha-30-construction/
Total questions: 600

OSHA 30-Hour Construction is a voluntary outreach training program for supervisors and workers with safety responsibilities. It covers everything in OSHA 10 plus managing safety and health, the OSHA Focus Four hazards in greater depth, expanded electives, and Foundations for Safety Leadership. Many states, contractors, and project labor agreements require OSHA 30 for foremen, superintendents, and site safety personnel.

### Domains
- 1.0 Introduction to OSHA (7% of exam): 40 questions
- 2.0 Managing Safety and Health (8% of exam): 50 questions
- 3.0 Focus Four: Falls (12% of exam): 70 questions
- 4.0 Focus Four: Electrocution (8% of exam): 45 questions
- 5.0 Focus Four: Struck-By (7% of exam): 45 questions
- 6.0 Focus Four: Caught-In or Between (8% of exam): 45 questions
- 7.0 Personal Protective Equipment (7% of exam): 40 questions
- 8.0 Health Hazards in Construction (7% of exam): 45 questions
- 9.0 Stairways and Ladders (6% of exam): 35 questions
- 10.0 Elective Construction Topics (30% of exam): 185 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Is there a final exam for OSHA 30?**
A: OSHA does not mandate one specific proctored exam, since the requirement is completing 30 hours of authorized outreach training. Most authorized providers include quizzes throughout the course and a final knowledge check, commonly with a 70% passing score and a few retry attempts, before issuing your DOL card.

**Q: Can you fail OSHA 30?**
A: You can miss the passing score on an individual module quiz with some providers, but you can typically retake it, since the program is built around completing all 30 hours of content rather than screening people out.

**Q: Is OSHA 30 online?**
A: Yes, OSHA-authorized outreach trainers offer it fully online or in person; both formats require the full 30 hours of authorized content for the DOL card.

**Q: How long does the OSHA 30 card last?**
A: It does not expire under federal rules, though some states, general contractors, and project labor agreements require periodic refreshers, so check your specific job requirements.

**Q: How much does OSHA 30 cost?**
A: OSHA does not set a fixed price since independent authorized providers deliver the training; expect roughly $70 to $150 depending on the provider and format, more than OSHA 10 given the extra 20 hours of content.

**Q: Who should take OSHA 30 instead of OSHA 10?**
A: OSHA 30 is intended for supervisors, foremen, site safety leads, and anyone with safety responsibility for others. OSHA 10 is the entry-level course for workers. Many states and contractors require the 30-hour card for supervisory roles.

## Forklift Operator Certification (OSHA 1910.178)
Vendor: OSHA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/forklift-certification/
Total questions: 300

Forklift Operator Certification is mandated by 29 CFR 1910.178 for any worker operating a powered industrial truck on the job. Training covers truck types and capacities, the physics of stability (fulcrum, center of gravity, stability triangle, load center), pre-operation inspection, safe load handling, operating around pedestrians, lifting personnel on work platforms, and the employer’s duty to evaluate and certify each operator at least every three years.

### Domains
- 1.0 Forklift Fundamentals and Markings (12% of exam): 35 questions
- 2.0 Components and Protective Features (10% of exam): 30 questions
- 3.0 Stability and Load Center (20% of exam): 60 questions
- 4.0 Seat Belt Safety and Operating Conditions (10% of exam): 30 questions
- 5.0 Safe Operation: Loads, Travel, and Shutdown (20% of exam): 60 questions
- 6.0 Pedestrian Safety and Work Platforms (11% of exam): 35 questions
- 7.0 Training, Evaluation, and Certification (17% of exam): 50 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Is the OSHA forklift test free?**
A: QuizBuffet’s forklift practice test is free, 300+ questions with instant feedback, no signup. The official employer-administered evaluation itself is not run by OSHA directly and is typically arranged (and paid for) through your employer or a training provider.

**Q: Can you get forklift certified online?**
A: The written knowledge portion can be completed online, but 29 CFR 1910.178(l) requires a hands-on performance evaluation of your actual operating skills, which must be done in person on the equipment you will use.

**Q: How many questions are on the forklift test?**
A: It varies by employer and training provider since OSHA does not publish one standard test; most written knowledge tests run 25 to 40 questions.

**Q: What does 29 CFR 1910.178 require?**
A: 29 CFR 1910.178 is OSHA’s Powered Industrial Trucks standard. It requires formal training on truck types and operation, a hands-on evaluation of each operator, refresher training after certain incidents or unsafe operation, and re-evaluation of every operator at least once every three years.

**Q: How often do you need forklift recertification?**
A: At least every 3 years under 1910.178, though a near-miss, accident, unsafe operation, or a switch to a different truck type can trigger earlier refresher training.

**Q: What is a passing score for the forklift test?**
A: OSHA does not set one fixed passing score since the written test and evaluation criteria are set by the employer or training provider; most programs require correctly demonstrating every required skill on the hands-on evaluation, not just a percentage on the written portion.

## CDL Class A (CDL-A)
Vendor: FMCSA / State DMV
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/cdl-class-a/
Total questions: 300

CDL Class A licensing is governed by 49 CFR Part 383 and administered by state DMVs under the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). The knowledge component covers driver qualifications and disqualifications, hours of service, safe driving and hazard recognition, cargo securement, the air brake system and 7-step inspection, combination vehicles and coupling/uncoupling, the pre-trip vehicle inspection, and basic vehicle control maneuvers. A Class A CDL is required to operate any combination vehicle with a gross combination weight rating (GCWR) over 26,001 pounds when the towed unit exceeds 10,000 pounds.

### Domains
- 1.0 Driver Qualifications and CDL Fundamentals (6% of exam): 18 questions
- 2.0 Driving Safely and On-Road Operation (25% of exam): 75 questions
- 3.0 Transporting Cargo Safely (10% of exam): 30 questions
- 4.0 Air Brakes (20% of exam): 60 questions
- 5.0 Combination Vehicles (15% of exam): 45 questions
- 6.0 Pre-Trip Vehicle Inspection (15% of exam): 45 questions
- 7.0 Basic Vehicle Control and Maneuvering (9% of exam): 27 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the CDL general knowledge test?**
A: Most states use a 50-question general knowledge test as the core written exam every CDL applicant must pass.

**Q: How many questions are on the CDL combination vehicles test?**
A: Most states use a 20-question combination vehicles test, required for a Class A license since it covers coupling, uncoupling, and handling articulated vehicles.

**Q: How many questions are on the CDL air brakes test?**
A: Most states use a 25-question air brakes test. If you skip it or fail it, you can still get a CDL but with an air brake restriction that prevents you from driving vehicles equipped with air brakes.

**Q: What is the passing score for the CDL written test?**
A: Most states require 80% correct on each section (general knowledge, air brakes, combination vehicles) to pass.

**Q: Is the CDL pretest the same as the permit test?**
A: Yes, in most usage "CDL pretest" and "CDL permit test" refer to the same thing: the written knowledge test you pass to get your commercial learner's permit (CLP) before scheduling the behind-the-wheel skills test.

**Q: Can I take the CDL test online?**
A: The written knowledge test is administered at a state DMV or approved testing location, not taken independently online, though some states now offer computer-based testing on-site. QuizBuffet's free practice test is online and lets you study before you go in.

## Georgia Real Estate Salesperson License (Real Estate License)
Vendor: Georgia Real Estate Commission / PSI
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/real-estate-license/
Total questions: 300

The Georgia Real Estate Salesperson Examination is administered by PSI (which acquired the former AMP testing program) for the Georgia Real Estate Commission (GREC). The full exam is 152 multiple-choice items combining the National Real Estate portion (100 items across seven content areas: agency relationships and contracts, real property ownership and interest, finance, real property and valuation, marketing regulations, property management, and real estate calculations) with the Georgia Salesperson Supplement (52 items covering state laws and rules, real estate practice in Georgia, and finance and closing). Candidates must complete a 75-hour Georgia-approved prelicense course, pass the exam at 75%, secure a sponsoring broker for active licensure, and complete a 25-hour postlicense course in their first year.

### Domains
- 1.0 Agency Relationships and Contracts (19% of exam): 56 questions
- 2.0 Real Property Ownership and Interest (9% of exam): 28 questions
- 3.0 Finance (10% of exam): 30 questions
- 4.0 Real Property (9% of exam): 28 questions
- 5.0 Marketing Regulations (5% of exam): 16 questions
- 6.0 Property Management (5% of exam): 16 questions
- 7.0 Real Estate Calculations (9% of exam): 26 questions
- 8.0 State Laws & Rules (Georgia) (11% of exam): 32 questions
- 9.0 Real Estate Practice in Georgia (14% of exam): 42 questions
- 10.0 Finance & Closing (Georgia) (9% of exam): 26 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Who administers the Georgia real estate exam?**
A: PSI administers the exam for the Georgia Real Estate Commission (GREC). PSI acquired the AMP testing program, so older materials may still reference AMP, but exams are now scheduled and delivered through PSI test centers.

**Q: How many questions are on the Georgia real estate exam?**
A: 152 scored multiple-choice questions: 100 on the National Real Estate portion and 52 on the Georgia Salesperson Supplement.

**Q: What is the passing score for the Georgia real estate exam?**
A: You need 75% correct.

**Q: How much does the Georgia real estate exam cost?**
A: PSI charges a testing fee of about $121 per attempt, paid when you schedule; check the current PSI Georgia candidate bulletin because the fee changes. That is separate from your prelicense course cost and the $170 GREC license application fee.

**Q: Is the Georgia real estate exam hard?**
A: It covers a lot of ground across national real estate principles and Georgia-specific law in one sitting, and the calculations section trips up many candidates. Most people who complete the full 75-hour prelicense course and drill practice questions pass on the first attempt.

**Q: What happens if you fail the Georgia real estate exam?**
A: You can retake it; GREC and PSI allow retakes for a new testing fee each time, with no long mandatory waiting period, though you should use the time to review whichever section (national or state) you missed.

## NMLS Mortgage Loan Originator (MLO) (SAFE MLO)
Vendor: NMLS
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/nmls-mlo/
Total questions: 300

The SAFE MLO National Test with Uniform State Content is required by the federal SAFE Act for any individual originating residential mortgage loans. The test consists of 120 multiple-choice items (115 scored, 5 unscored) across five content areas: Federal Mortgage-Related Laws (24%), Uniform State Content (11%), General Mortgage Knowledge (20%), Mortgage Loan Origination Activities (27%), and Ethics (18%). Federal coverage is anchored on 12 CFR Parts 1024, 1002, 1026, 1003, 1022, 1016, 1014, and 1008, RESPA (Reg X), ECOA (Reg B), TILA (Reg Z), HMDA (Reg C), FCRA (Reg V), Privacy (Reg P), MAP advertising (Reg N), and SAFE Act compliance (Reg H).

### Domains
- 1.0 Federal Mortgage-Related Laws (24% of exam): 72 questions
- 2.0 Uniform State Content (11% of exam): 33 questions
- 3.0 General Mortgage Knowledge (20% of exam): 60 questions
- 4.0 Mortgage Loan Origination Activities (27% of exam): 81 questions
- 5.0 Ethics (18% of exam): 54 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: What is on the SAFE MLO national test?**
A: 120 multiple-choice items (115 scored, 5 unscored) in 190 minutes, covering Federal Mortgage-Related Laws, Uniform State Content, General Mortgage Knowledge, Mortgage Loan Origination Activities, and Ethics.

**Q: What is the passing score for the SAFE MLO exam?**
A: You need 75%.

**Q: How much does the SAFE MLO exam cost?**
A: The national test costs $110 through NMLS, plus a separate fee if your state requires the Uniform State Content component (most states now use the national test with UST built in).

**Q: How many times can you take the SAFE test?**
A: You can retake it, but NMLS enforces waiting periods: 30 days after each of your first 3 attempts, then 180 days after a 4th or any later failed attempt.

**Q: Is there a free NMLS practice test?**
A: Yes, QuizBuffet’s SAFE MLO practice test is 300+ free questions organized by the same five content areas as the real exam, no signup required.

**Q: What is the UST (Uniform State Content)?**
A: Uniform State Content is the portion of the national test covering state-level mortgage law and licensing requirements that apply across participating states, folded directly into the national SAFE test rather than given as a separate exam.

## FAA Part 107 / 14 CFR Part 107 (Part 107)
Vendor: FAA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/faa-part-107/
Total questions: 300

FAA Part 107 is the Remote Pilot Certificate with a small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) rating, required by 14 CFR Part 107 for any commercial drone operation in the United States. The initial knowledge test (UAG) is administered by PSI at FAA-approved testing centers and consists of 60 multiple-choice questions covering five Areas of Operation from the FAA Airman Certification Standards (FAA-S-ACS-10B): Regulations, Airspace and Operating Requirements, Weather, Loading and Performance, and Operations. Candidates pass with 70% (42 of 60). After August 2024, recurrent currency is satisfied through the free online ALC-677 training every 24 months instead of a recurrent knowledge test.

### Domains
- 1.0 Regulations: Core (14% of exam): 42 questions
- 2.0 Operations Over People (5% of exam): 15 questions
- 3.0 Remote Identification (3% of exam): 9 questions
- 4.0 Airspace Classification and Operational Requirements (20% of exam): 60 questions
- 5.0 Weather (13% of exam): 39 questions
- 6.0 Loading and Performance (9% of exam): 27 questions
- 7.0 Radio Communications and Airport Operations (11% of exam): 33 questions
- 8.0 Emergency Procedures and Aeronautical Decision-Making (14% of exam): 42 questions
- 9.0 Physiology and Maintenance (11% of exam): 33 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Is the Part 107 test multiple choice?**
A: Yes. All 60 questions on the FAA Part 107 UAG knowledge test are multiple choice, with 3 answer options each.

**Q: How many questions are on the Part 107 exam?**
A: 60 multiple-choice questions in a 2-hour window.

**Q: What is the passing score for Part 107?**
A: You need 70%, or 42 of 60 questions correct.

**Q: How do you renew a Part 107 certificate?**
A: Since August 2024, you renew by completing the free FAA online recurrent training course (ALC-677) every 24 months, no in-person retest required.

**Q: Is the Part 107 test hard?**
A: Most people find the airspace classification and weather sections the hardest, since they require reading sectional charts and METARs rather than pure memorization. With focused study, most candidates pass on the first attempt.

**Q: How much does the Part 107 test cost?**
A: The knowledge test fee is $175, paid to PSI when you schedule at an FAA-approved testing center. It is non-refundable, and a retake costs the same again. The IACRA application, TSA vetting, and the certificate itself are free.

## Certified Personal Trainer (NASM-CPT) (NASM-CPT)
Vendor: NASM
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/personal-trainer-nasm/
Total questions: 900

The NASM Certified Personal Trainer (NASM-CPT) credential is an NCCA-accredited certification administered by the National Academy of Sports Medicine. The certification exam consists of 120 multiple-choice questions delivered over a 2-hour window through PSI testing centers, with a passing score of 70%. Content is anchored on the NASM CPT Exam Content Outline (current 7th edition), organized into six domains: Basic and Applied Sciences and Nutritional Concepts, Client Relations and Behavioral Coaching, Assessment, Program Design, Exercise Technique and Training Instruction, and Professional Development and Responsibility. NASM's programming framework is the Optimum Performance Training (OPT) model, which sequences clients through stabilization endurance, strength endurance, hypertrophy, maximal strength, and power phases. This QuizBuffet bank weights its 900 questions toward foundational sciences (anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, energy systems, nutrition) so candidates have generous drill volume on the material that everything else builds on.

### Domains
- 1.0 Basic and Applied Sciences and Nutritional Concepts (46% of exam): 408 questions
- 2.0 Client Relations and Behavioral Coaching (11% of exam): 100 questions
- 3.0 Assessment (11% of exam): 100 questions
- 4.0 Program Design (7% of exam): 64 questions
- 5.0 Exercise Technique and Training Instruction (14% of exam): 128 questions
- 6.0 Professional Development and Responsibility (11% of exam): 100 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: How many questions are on the NASM CPT exam?**
A: 120 multiple-choice questions in a 2-hour window at a PSI testing center.

**Q: What is the passing score for NASM CPT?**
A: 70% on NASM’s scaled score.

**Q: How much does NASM CPT cost?**
A: NASM sells the exam bundled into study packages rather than as a standalone fee, typically ranging from around $600 for a self-study package to well over $1,000 for packages with live mentoring and continuing education included. Check NASM’s official site for current package pricing.

**Q: Can you retake the NASM CPT exam?**
A: Yes. If you do not pass, NASM allows a retake after a waiting period, generally for an additional retake fee, and gives you a second attempt within your exam eligibility window.

**Q: Is NASM CPT hard?**
A: Most candidates find the foundational sciences domain (anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, and the OPT model) the hardest part since it carries the most weight and everything else builds on it. With steady study, most candidates pass; NASM reports pass rates in the 60 to 70 percent range on the first attempt.

**Q: NASM vs ACE, which certification is better?**
A: Both are NCCA-accredited and widely accepted by gyms. NASM leans heavily on its Optimum Performance Training (OPT) model and corrective exercise, which many trainers find gives more structured programming guidance; ACE is often described as slightly more accessible for newcomers. Employers rarely require one over the other.

## CPR / AED Certification (CPR/AED)
Vendor: American Red Cross / AHA
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/cpr-aed/
Total questions: 300

CPR / AED Certification is the lay-rescuer credential for responding to sudden cardiac arrest, choking, and other breathing emergencies. The knowledge component is standardized across the American Heart Association and American Red Cross and is built on the AHA Guidelines for CPR & ECC: scene safety, the Chain of Survival, recognition of cardiac arrest, high-quality compressions and ventilations for adults, children, and infants, AED operation, choking response, and special situations such as opioid overdose, drowning, and pregnancy. Required for many healthcare, education, fitness, lifeguard, and child-care roles, and broadly recommended for any responsible adult.

### Domains
- 1.0 Introduction and Chain of Survival (8% of exam): 24 questions
- 2.0 Assessment and Recognition (12% of exam): 36 questions
- 3.0 Adult CPR (22% of exam): 65 questions
- 4.0 Child and Infant CPR (18% of exam): 54 questions
- 5.0 AED Operation (18% of exam): 55 questions
- 6.0 Choking and Airway Obstruction (12% of exam): 36 questions
- 7.0 Special Situations and Recovery (10% of exam): 30 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: Where can I find free CPR test questions and answers?**
A: QuizBuffet’s CPR and AED practice test gives you 300+ free multiple-choice questions with instant answers and explanations, no signup required. Practice one domain at a time (compressions, AED use, choking, and more) or run a mixed session that mirrors the real exam.

**Q: Can you do CPR and AED training online?**
A: The knowledge portion can be done online through blended courses like AHA HeartCode, but a hands-on skills check with an instructor is still required to get certified. QuizBuffet’s free practice test covers that knowledge portion so you walk into the skills check ready.

**Q: What do you need to know to pass a CPR test?**
A: Focus on the Chain of Survival, correct compression rate and depth for adults, children, and infants, when and how to use an AED, and the choking response. Most CPR/AED written exams require 80% or better, so working through practice questions by domain is the fastest way to find your weak spots before test day.

**Q: Which comes first, CPR or AED?**
A: Start CPR immediately, and use the AED the moment it arrives; you do not finish a full round of CPR first. If you are alone, call 911 and get the AED yourself; if others are present, send someone for the AED while you begin compressions right away.

**Q: What kind of questions are on the CPR test?**
A: Most CPR/AED exams are multiple choice. They cover the Chain of Survival, how to check responsiveness and breathing, compression rate and depth for adults, children, and infants, how to use an AED, and how to help someone who is choking. QuizBuffet mirrors that exact mix across all seven domains.

**Q: How hard is it to get AED certified?**
A: Not very. An AED is designed for untrained bystanders, so the device speaks each step out loud as you go. Most courses pair a short written test with a hands-on skill check, and the written part usually asks for around 80% or better to pass.

## QuickBooks ProAdvisor (Online Certification) (QuickBooks ProAdvisor)
Vendor: Intuit

The QuickBooks ProAdvisor program is Intuit's free certification for accounting and bookkeeping professionals. Certification is delivered through training courses on QuickBooks Online Accountant; candidates pass each module quiz at 80% and the final exam at 80%, with three attempts per module. The Advanced ProAdvisor Certification builds on the basic certification with deeper QBO functionality and advisory workflows.

### Sample questions

**Q: What is on the ProAdvisor exam?**
A: The QBO Certification covers setup and subscriptions, navigation and settings, list management, the chart of accounts, customer and sales workflows, vendor and purchase workflows, banking and reconciliation, reports, and payroll basics, roughly 50 questions per module, with an 80% passing score and 3 attempts per module.

**Q: How long does the ProAdvisor exam take?**
A: There is no strict time limit on most modules, but plan for several hours total since the certification is split across multiple modules with their own quizzes plus a final exam.

**Q: Do you need to be an accountant?**
A: No. Anyone can create a free QuickBooks Online Accountant account and complete the ProAdvisor certification, though it is designed for bookkeepers, accountants, and QuickBooks consultants.

**Q: How long is ProAdvisor certification valid?**
A: ProAdvisor certifications require annual recertification. Intuit notifies you when your certification exam needs to be retaken to stay current.

## Basic Life Support (BLS) (BLS)
Vendor: American Heart Association
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/bls/
Total questions: 300

BLS (Basic Life Support) certifies healthcare professionals to deliver high-quality CPR, use an AED, provide ventilation with barrier devices and bag-mask, relieve choking, and work as part of a high-performance resuscitation team for adults, children, and infants. Required for nurses, physicians, EMTs, paramedics, dental and respiratory professionals, and most clinical roles. Built around the AHA Chain of Survival, 2020 BLS Guidelines (with 2023 focused updates), and the AHA BLS Provider course; renewal is typically every two years.

### Domains
- 1.0 Course Concepts and Chain of Survival (6% of exam): 18 questions
- 2.0 Assessment and High-Performance Teams (12% of exam): 36 questions
- 3.0 Adult BLS (1- and 2-Rescuer) (22% of exam): 66 questions
- 4.0 Pediatric BLS (Children and Infants) (18% of exam): 54 questions
- 5.0 AED for All Ages (16% of exam): 48 questions
- 6.0 Alternate Ventilation and Advanced Airways (8% of exam): 24 questions
- 7.0 Choking Relief Across Ages (10% of exam): 30 questions
- 8.0 Special Emergencies and Recovery (8% of exam): 24 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: What is on the AHA BLS exam?**
A: The BLS written exam covers the Chain of Survival, high-quality CPR for adults, children, and infants, AED use, ventilation with a bag-mask device, choking relief, and working as part of a resuscitation team. It pairs with a hands-on skills test for the in-person provider card.

**Q: What is BLS Exam A vs Exam B?**
A: The AHA issues two equivalent 25-question versions, Exam A and Exam B, so instructors can give a different version on a retake. Both cover the same content at the same difficulty; QuizBuffet’s question bank draws from both.

**Q: What is the passing score for BLS?**
A: You need 84%, or 21 of 25 questions correct, on the written exam, plus a successful hands-on skills check.

**Q: Is the BLS test online?**
A: The knowledge portion can be completed online through AHA HeartCode BLS, but you still need an in-person skills session with an instructor to get the provider card. QuizBuffet’s free practice test and mock test questions cover that online knowledge portion.

**Q: How long is BLS valid?**
A: BLS certification from the American Heart Association is valid for two years, after which you renew with a shorter refresher course.

**Q: Is BLS the same as CPR?**
A: BLS builds on CPR and AED skills with additional content aimed at healthcare professionals: team-based resuscitation, advanced airway ventilation, and recognizing deterioration before cardiac arrest. A general CPR/AED course is aimed at lay rescuers and covers less ground.

## Cosmetology License (Cosmetology)
Vendor: State Boards
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/cosmetology-license/
Total questions: 300

A Cosmetology License is required in every U.S. state to perform haircutting, chemical services, skin care, and nail care for compensation. State exams typically follow the NIC (National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology) National Theory blueprint, administered by PSI or a similar testing vendor as a written exam plus a hands-on practical. The written exam covers four areas: scientific concepts (infection control, anatomy and physiology, chemistry, electricity), hair care and services (cutting, styling, color, chemical texture, hair structure), skin care and services (facials, hair removal, skin analysis), and nail care and services (manicures, pedicures, enhancements, nail disorders).

### Domains
- 1.0 Scientific Concepts (31% of exam): 92 questions
- 2.0 Hair Care and Services (37% of exam): 118 questions
- 3.0 Skin Care and Services (17% of exam): 49 questions
- 4.0 Nail Care and Services (15% of exam): 41 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: What is on the cosmetology state board written exam?**
A: Most states use the NIC National Cosmetology Theory exam or a state version of it. It covers scientific concepts (infection control, anatomy, chemistry), hair care and services, skin care and services, and nail care and services. A separate hands-on practical exam is also required in most states.

**Q: How many questions are on the cosmetology theory exam?**
A: Typically 90 to 110 multiple-choice questions with 90 minutes to two hours, depending on your state. Ten or so items are usually unscored pilot questions.

**Q: What is the passing score for the cosmetology exam?**
A: Your state board sets it. Most states require 70 to 75 percent on the written exam, and the practical is scored separately.

**Q: Can I take the cosmetology exam online?**
A: The written exam is usually taken at a PSI or Prometric testing center, and some states offer remote proctoring. The practical must be done in person on a mannequin or model.

**Q: How many hours do I need before I can sit for the cosmetology exam?**
A: It varies by state, most commonly 1,000 to 1,600 hours of approved school training. Check your state board because apprenticeship paths and reciprocity rules differ.

**Q: What happens if I fail the cosmetology exam?**
A: You can retake it after paying the exam fee again. Most states let you retake only the section you failed and have no long waiting period, but a few limit attempts before requiring more training.

## Advanced Practice Micropigmentation (Micropigmentation)
Vendor: NIC
URL: https://quizbuffet.com/micropigmentation/
Total questions: 210

The NIC National Advanced Practice Micropigmentation Theory Examination is the licensure theory exam for advanced cosmetic tattoo procedures (permanent makeup, paramedical micropigmentation, scalp pigmentation, areola restoration, scar repigmentation) authored by the National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology (NIC) and adopted by participating state boards. The blueprint covers three domains: Scientific Concepts (infection control, skin and tissue structure, human anatomy and physiology, skin disorders, equipment and pigment storage), Micropigmentation Procedures (client communication and documentation, skin preparation, color theory, pre-application design, and application technique), and Side Effects and Possible Complications. Candidates are expected to anchor their knowledge in the Society of Permanent Cosmetic Professionals (SPCP) standards, NIC Infection Control and Safety Standards, and Milady's Aesthetician Series Permanent Makeup: Tips and Techniques.

### Domains
- 1.0 Scientific Concepts (46% of exam): 96 questions
- 2.0 Micropigmentation Procedures (50% of exam): 104 questions
- 3.0 Side Effects and Possible Complications (4% of exam): 10 questions

### Sample questions
**Q: What is on the micropigmentation theory exam?**
A: 110 multiple-choice items (100 weighted for scoring) in 90 minutes, covering infection control, anatomy and physiology, and the procedures and complications specific to permanent makeup, paramedical, and cosmetic tattoo work.

**Q: What is the passing score for the micropigmentation exam?**
A: Your state board sets the exact cutoff, since NIC exams are adopted state by state; most states require 70 to 75%.

**Q: Is there a hands-on exam for micropigmentation too?**
A: Most states require a hands-on practical evaluation in addition to the written theory exam, similar to tattoo and cosmetology licensing.

**Q: Is micropigmentation the same as permanent makeup?**
A: They overlap heavily. "Micropigmentation" is the broader technical term for depositing pigment in the skin (covering permanent makeup, paramedical work like areola restoration, and cosmetic tattooing); some states license these separately, others combine them.

**Q: Is this micropigmentation practice test free?**
A: Yes. All micropigmentation practice questions on QuizBuffet are free, organized by domain, with explanations for every answer and no signup.

## Barber License (Barber)

A Barber License is required in every U.S. state to perform haircutting, shaving, beard design, chemical hair services, and basic skin and scalp care for compensation. Most states use the NIC (National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology) National Barber Theory Examination, a 60-item, 90-minute written exam, paired with a hands-on practical, both typically administered by PSI. The theory blueprint covers four domains: scientific concepts (infection control, anatomy and physiology, skin and hair disorders, product chemistry), implements and equipment (razors, shears, clippers, sanitation), hair care services (consultation, draping, shampoo, cutting, styling, chemical services), and facial hair and skin care services (shaving, facial hair design, facials, electrotherapy).

- 4.0 Facial Hair and Skin Care Services (14% of exam): 36 questions

**Q: What is on the barber state board written exam?**
A: Most states use the NIC National Barber Theory exam or a state version of it. It covers scientific concepts (infection control, anatomy, chemistry), hair care services, facial hair and skin care services, and implements and equipment. A hands-on practical exam is also required in most states.

**Q: How many questions are on the barber theory exam?**
A: The NIC barber theory exam has 60 items, of which 50 are scored, with 90 minutes to complete it. State versions vary slightly.

**Q: How many training hours do I need for a barber license?**
